findings.quote: "no grace period — processed by the next cron tick" (propose a `cancel_account_deletion()` RPC + 7-day grace as a later step if I want one)
findings.problem: The prompt implements immediate, irreversible deletion and no Deactivate path. Orchestrator decision 15 (which 6.4, 6.5 and 6.6 in this same group already assume: 'Deactivate/Delete rows', '30-day window') requires: a Deactivate account action (archive, reversible, sign out, push devices deleted), Delete = archive now with `scheduled_for = requested_at + 30 days` (`ACCOUNT_DELETION_GRACE_DAYS = 30`), `srv_process_account_deletions()` processing only rows whose `scheduled_for` has passed, cancel paths (sign in → 'Keep my account'; super admin in `/admin`), super-admin Restore (users list → Archived → Restore) and super-admin-initiated deletion requests, archived accounts treated as non-members by the `app.*` helpers, the two-button UI copy, and an explicit statement of BOTH schema cases (columns/RPCs already in `9999_init.sql` via the G2/G3 fixers, or shipped by 6.3a in the next free `999x_*` migration if 9999 is already pasted). None of this is in the Goal, Inputs, Build, Verify, done_when or notes; the Inputs even describe `account_deletion_requests` as `(user_id, requested_at, processed_at)` with no `scheduled_for`, and the copy says 'the request cannot be undone once processed'. A fresh agent following this prompt builds the wrong product and 6.4/6.5/6.6 then reference screens and copy that do not exist.
findings.fix: Rewrite 6.3a around decision 15. Inputs: add the per-user table columns `archived_at timestamptz`, `archived_by uuid`, `archive_reason ('user'|'deletion_request'|'admin')`, `account_deletion_requests.scheduled_for timestamptz`, client RPC `deactivate_account()`, service RPCs `srv_archive_account(user_id, reason)` / `srv_restore_account(user_id)`, and the sentence: 'Case A — the HANDOFF ledger shows `9999_init.sql` NOT pasted: the columns, RPCs, policies and RLS tests were added to 9999 by steps 1.2–1.4 (verify with `grep -n "archived_at\|deactivate_account\|srv_archive_account\|scheduled_for" supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql`); build only UI, cron proof and docs. Case B — 9999 is pasted: ship the same schema in the next free descending migration named in the ledger (`9996_account_archival.sql` if free), re-runnable per docs/MIGRATIONS.md, with its own RLS test, and add the ready-to-paste ledger row.' Build: (1) `11_account_deletion.sql` asserts `deactivate_account()` sets `archived_at`/`archive_reason='user'`, deletes the caller's `push_devices`, and the archived user vanishes from `app.member_org_ids()`, `srv_audience_user_ids`, `directory_persons`; `request_account_deletion()` archives with reason `deletion_request` and sets `scheduled_for = requested_at + interval '30 days'`; `srv_process_account_deletions()` returns 0 while `scheduled_for > now()` and processes after `set local` clock or a fixture with a past `scheduled_for`; cancel (delete request row + `srv_restore_account`) restores memberships/permissions/visibility. (2) Web: `/account` gains two buttons with the decision-15 copy strings verbatim in `deletion-copy.ts` ('Deactivate account — hides you from your church and signs you out; your data is kept so an administrator can restore you later' / 'Delete account — permanently deletes your account and data after 30 days unless you cancel'); `/account/deactivate` confirm → `deactivate_account()` → sign out; `/login` after sign-in detects an archived account and shows 'Restore my account' (user-initiated restore, recommended default) or, for a pending deletion, 'Keep my account' which deletes the request row and restores; `/admin` users list → 'Archived' filter → Restore and 'Start deletion request' Server Actions calling `srv_restore_account`/`srv_archive_account` through the service client after `requireSuperAdmin()`. (3) Mobile: More tab rows 'Deactivate account' and 'Delete account' with the same copy; `app/account/deactivate.tsx` next to `delete.tsx`; the Delete screen states the 30-day window. (4) Cron test: the final phase processes only due rows. Update Goal, Verify, done_when and Finish (Decisions: 'ACCOUNT_DELETION_GRACE_DAYS = 30, user restore allowed — founder may veto'). Because this pushes 6.3a well past one session, split per decision 13: keep `6.3a` = DB proof for both schema cases + `@church/db` wrappers + web `/account/*`, sign-in restore/keep prompts and `/admin` restore; new `6.3c` (depends_on ['6.3a','4.3']) = mobile Deactivate/Delete screens + legal text copy (decision 19) + `docs/PLAY_DATA_SAFETY.md`; repoint 6.3b, 6.6 and 6.5 to depend on 6.3c where they need the mobile screens or the worksheet.
